Senior Business Analyst (Payments and Cards) Every day at FIS, innovators, problem solvers and changemakers work together to create technology that advances the world of finance. We embrace new ideas, challenge what's possible and empower our teams to make a lasting impact. If you're ready to help shape the future of fintech, unlock your next chapter with FIS. 
 About the role : This role captures being recognized as a master in their discipline and responsible for integrating both new and existing processes align with the organizations strategic goals. Responsibilities involves addressing undefined and-complex problems that require extensive information gathering and innovative solutions. Frequent communication with senior personnel both internally and externally, including customers and vendors. Colleague will lead initiatives, drive change, and shape objectives within their area of responsibility. This role requires mastery-level knowledge in a specialized field, typically supported by advanced education and substantial experience, with potential expertise in project management. 
 Your key responsibilities You will participate in the delivery of card migration programmes as a co-lead owning the end-to-end requirements and solution design or act as a business subject matter owning the requirements and solution design within your functional area of expertise in the payments cards domain. As a co-lead you will work closely with clients and senior stakeholders to shape efficiently best-practice outcomes and ensure strong governance throughout while negotiating with the intention of achieving the best suited solution approach for clients and FIS. Acting as a bridge between business and technology, you will guide teams, remove obstacles, and ensure solutions are clearly defined, validated, and successfully implemented. Participate in large and complex client engagement to lead and own various requirements elicitation sessions. Act as a Business SME providing product consultancy support to clients and educate clients on system features and functionality where required. Act as a Requirements Lead having overall accountability and responsibility for the requirements phase of the project. Consult on best practice solutions for meeting the needs and improving efficiency and effectiveness of the client's future state. Own development requirements matrix, manage feasibility review with product and technology teams, and obtain client sign-off of the agreed development scope. Work with product and technology teams to obtain high-level development approaches and effort estimates for identified gaps. Manage expectations and needs of clients during the requirements cycle regarding the functionality of the solution and making recommendations about the usage where appropriate. Manage in a matrix management manner a team of senior or lead Architects for assigned projects and be responsible for assigning, directing and monitoring the work. Provide direction on gaps, complex decisions, integrations, and proposed solutions to senior and lead Architects. Plan requirement workstream resourcing, mentor Senior Architects, resolve escalations, and reallocate work when required. Work with senior stakeholders within FIS and Client organisations and build and maintain strong relationships and ensure proper governance and management is in place. Help defining standards and advise on best practices. Facilitate discussions that minimize unnecessary development while meeting client requirements. Participate in Migration Strategy and Data Mapping activities, explaining agreed configurations and non-development workarounds. Identify and document migration impacts arising from functional requirements and proposed solutions. Identify, escalate, and monitor project risks with Programme/Project Management. Maintain control and governance over the agreed timeline of all discovery related deliverables.Own cross-workstream coordination, including communicating impacts among functional, technical, migration, infrastructure, and programme teams. Safeguard the agreed Discovery and change-management processes, avoiding ad-hoc requests that introduce unmanaged risk or overhead. 
 What you bring: 
 Required Qualifications 10+ years relevant experience in business requirements analysis, gathering, documentation and validation for software projects. Experience in the Card Payments industry. Experience in requirement matrix management, leading and managing a group of Architects Experience in a client advisory/consultancy role in an IT environment. Conversant with Productivity tools like MSWord/Google Docs, MS Excel/Google Sheets, MS PowerPoint/Google Slides, MS Visio/Lucid Charts. Ability to communicate clearly and concisely and to interact with both Business and IT partners to define, understand and evaluate business requirements Must be a team player with excellent interpersonal and relationship skills Flexibility to travel to client premises Excellent spoken and written English communication skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications : Domain with business analysis certification will be an add-on. 
 Added bonus if you have: Understanding of data structures Previous experience in FIS PRIME card management systems or similar card management systems. Experience in large scale projects, such as a portfolio conversion of a product launch. Professional experience working with end-users to meet business needs. Professional experience demonstrating transferable skills for business analysis. Working towards or in possession of a business analysis professional qualification e.g. IIBA or BCS). Experience with the use of common AI tools. 
 What we offer you : Bring your ideas. Build your future. At FIS, you'll find the support, resources and opportunities to develop your career while helping shape the future of financial technology.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Business Analyst – Data, Analytics and AI**
**The Opportunity**
 As a Business Analyst (Data, Analytics and AI) at EY, you will play a pivotal role in shaping, governing, and delivering data‑driven and AI‑enabled solutions for Clients \& Industries (C\&I) and select EY‑wide initiatives. You will be part of the Data Strategy team, operating at the intersection of business, analytics, and AI to ensure that Analytics and Copilot‑led agentic solutions are aligned to strategic objectives and deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 This role combines hands‑on delivery with ownership of analytics and AI governance, operating models, and value realization. You will act as the Business Analyst on Data Analytics and AI initiatives, while also contributing to data strategy, metric standardization, and trusted data foundations across C\&I.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Business Analysis \& Stakeholder Leadership**
* Lead discovery and requirements definition for data, analytics, and AI initiatives across Clients \& Industries.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to shape business problems into clear analytics and AI use cases with defined success measures.
* Translate business needs into structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria aligned to delivery backlogs.
* Act as a trusted advisor, balancing strategic objectives with execution‑focused delivery.


**Data Strategy, Governance \& Operating Model**
* Contribute to C\&I data strategy by identifying priority data domains, decision journeys, and analytics opportunities.
* Define and govern enterprise KPIs, metrics, and reporting standards to ensure consistency and trust.
* Maintain business glossaries, metric definitions, and analytics standards aligned with data governance practices.


**Data Collection, Data Quality \& Trusted Data**
* Define data collection requirements including sources, granularity, frequency, ownership, and quality expectations.
* Identify data gaps, quality issues, and remediation needs. Establish validation rules and “trusted data” criteria for analytics and AI use cases.
* Ensure compliance with EY data security, privacy, and regulatory standards, including GDPR.


**Analytics Delivery, Insights \& Value Realization**
* Partner with analytics teams to deliver actionable insights and executive‑ready narratives.
* Validate dashboards, reports, and AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, and business alignment.
* Drive adoption through enablement, walkthroughs, and targeted stakeholder communication.
* Identify optimization opportunities to enhance analytics and AI impact.
* Provide functional guidance to junior Data Engineers and ensure clarity of requirements and priorities.
* Collaborate across global, multi‑disciplinary C\&I teams to deliver outcomes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* AI‑first mindset with strong interest in Copilot‑led solutions and intelligent automation.
* Strong Business Analysis capability in data‑ and analytics‑heavy environments.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands‑on delivery and execution rigor.
* Executive presence and confidence engaging senior stakeholders as a trusted partner.
* Strong relationship‑building and influencing skills across business and technology teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complexity.
* Strong judgment, structured thinking, and operational discipline in a fast‑paced environment.
* Ability to operate effectively across geographies, cultures, and service lines.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong working knowledge of data and analytics concepts (KPIs, data models, data quality, data lineage).
* Proficiency in SQL for data validation and analysis; familiarity with Python is advantageous.
* Experience with Power BI (preferred) or similar visualization tools (Tableau, Spotfire).
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure analytics services (e.g., Data Factory, Synapse, Data Lake) from a requirements and design perspective.
* Experience with Copilot Studio for defining and validating AI agent solutions.
* Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) integration patterns.
* Exposure to Alteryx preferred but not mandatory.


**What We Look For**
* We are looking for Manager‑level professionals who can combine data strategy, analytics delivery, and AI enablement to drive tangible business outcomes for Clients \& Industries. You should be a structured problem solver, a strong communicator, and a collaborative leader who can operate comfortably across strategy, governance, and execution.
* If you are excited about shaping data‑driven and Copilot‑enabled experiences at scale, we encourage you to apply and be part of our journey.
